summary_1line: Before battle, Krishna urges Arjuna to pray to Durga; Arjuna’s hymn wins the goddess’s blessing of victory over his foes.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna stands with folded hands beside his chariot while the goddess Durga appears radiant in the sky above Krishna and the battlefield.
Krishna points across the battlefield toward Bhishma surrounded by ranks of warriors like clouds encircling the sun.
Krishna and Arjuna seated together on their chariot blow their celestial conches as the armies prepare for war.
